name: PoChatQuest
summary:
PoChatQuest brings one-to-one PoChat text chat to a Quest panel.

Send and accept friend requests using PoChat user IDs, then exchange messages with friends using PoChat for PC. A PoChat account and an internet connection are required. Free accounts can be created on the official website through the link on the login screen.
